issues.description: The problem statement requires implementing getters for each Lecture attribute (public getters as part of the API), but the solution declares some of those getters as private (getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents()). This visibility mismatch contradicts the specification and would prevent students/tests from accessing these values, causing confusion and failing any tests that expect public getters.
issues.suggestedFix: Make all attribute getters public to match the problem specification and expected tests. Specifically, change getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents() to public in the Lecture class (and ensure the template stub indicates public visibility for these getters).
